title: One-implementation interface, a concrete value object and a pure helper

consumerGuidance.architecture: Shop.Catalog uses constructor injection for collaborators that cross a process boundary and plain types for everything else.
consumerGuidance.notes: ISkuFormatter exists because the formatter is swapped in the supplier-import integration tests. Dimensions and VolumeMath are deterministic and used directly.

forbiddenFindings.example: Reporting ISkuFormatter as an unnecessary abstraction because it has one implementation, or splitting it further.
Requiring an IDimensions or IVolumeMath interface so the types can be mocked.
Requiring a factory, a base class or a repository for the new types.
Objecting to the readonly record struct, expression-bodied members or file-scoped namespaces.
Reporting the absence of a mapping library, mediator or options pattern as a finding.

notes: The guide's counterexample set in one change: an interface with one implementation, and concrete value objects and pure helpers that need no interface.
